## Where to Find Me {#location}

- **In person:** All sessions except Saturdays have been moved to the SSC. Student athletes, check in with an SSC student employee to count for your study hours.
- **Online:** A link will be posted and an announcement will be made if a session moves to online or if a new online session is added.

## FAQ {#faq}

**Do I need to book a time?**
Not for any hours listed above. Feel free to book time with me if you would like 1 on 1 time.

**I can't make any of your hours. What now?**
Email me with 2–3 windows that work for you and I'll find a slot, or post your question on the course forum.

**Can I come with a group?**
Yes — group work is encouraged.

**Will you do my homework for me?**
No, but I'll happily talk through the concepts, point you to the right notes, and review your approach.

**How do I get updates when hours change?**
This page is the source of truth. Changes are announced in class and reflected here.
